DISCUSSION
D1.
Tree Ordinance/Street Tree Master Plan (CC)
1.
Introduce City Council Ordinance No. 2007- , entitled "An Ordinance of the Chartered City of Vista, California, Enacting Chapter 19.20 of the Vista Municipal Code Regarding Street Trees, Shrubs and Plants"; and
2.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2007- , approving the City of Vista Street Tree Master Plan and City Council Policy No. 900-03, Street Tree Service - Request for Financial Assistance.
PUBLIC HEARINGS - WILL BEGIN AT OR AFTER 6:00 P.M.
PH1.
Approvals for a 115-Unit Condominium Project at 1046 Sycamore Avenue, Sycamore Vista Partners, Applicant (CC)
1.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2007- , adopting a Mitigated Negative Declaration and a Mitigation Monitoring and Reporting Program;
2.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2007- , approving a General Plan Amendment to change the land use designation from Specific Plan Area (SPA) to Medium High Density Residential (MHD);
3.
Introduce City Council Ordinance No. 2007- , approving a Zone Change from Commercial (C-1) to Multi-Residential (R-M (15)) and approving a Specific Plan Amendment to remove the Green Oak Villas project area from Specific Plan 21 on eight acres at 1046 Sycamore Avenue; and
4.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2007- , approving a Site Development Plan, Condominium Housing Permit, Density Bonus, and Tentative Parcel Map for 115 condominium residential units and associated site improvements at 1046 Sycamore Avenue. CITY MANAGER REPORT
